title: Somehow went from the mall, through a door to this exclusive suburb
content: I was dreaming in the regular mall and became lucid next to the bathrooms, I kind of got lost admiring the tile that seemed fancier here like with blue inlay flowers on each corner, I walked through a door I didn't recognize and ended up in this vaguely Mediterranean neighborhood. I immediately registered that this wasn't " my part of town " anymore. The whimsy was gone, no weird AF carnivals or shops , just a quiet normal neighborhood and I got the distinct impression I should just keep moving, I eventually turned around and was able to go through the door again back to the mall into the annoying mc Escher painting stairwell ( I guess the elevators are preferable to something)
